description: Version pin for a value-constraint entry: the string "latest" or a version triple {id, effectiveDate, declaredVersion}. Absent means latest.

id.description: The content hash of the pinned release. It must hold a character that is not whitespace. The pattern lists every character Java's Character.isWhitespace counts as whitespace, so a validator refuses exactly the ids the model libraries refuse, whatever its regular-expression engine.
